cases.sentence: Лоэнгрин его звали, строгий такой… и весь в чирьях… и каждый вечер на ___ катался.
cases.explain: «моторной лодке» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: "We had a chairman—he was called Lohengrin—really strict and all covered with boils . . . and he’d go out every night for a motorboat ride and steer out onto the river. . and squeeze his boils .. ."’

cases.sentence: Губы его искривились, ___ его вспыхнул и погас.
cases.explain: «синий нос» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Suddenly Grandad fell silent. His lips became twisted, his blue nose flared up and went out. He cried. Cried like a woman, grabbing his head in his hands, his shoulders trembling and shaking in waves.

cases.sentence: За ___ Ивана Тургенева, гражданина прекрасной Франции!
cases.explain: «орловского дворянина» — after the preposition «за», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: "And all of you, let's drink. To the nobleman from Oryol, Ivan Turgenev, citizen of la belle France."

cases.explain: «орловского дворянина» — after the preposition «за», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.

cases.sentence: – Таких ___, – мрачно отозвался черноусый и снял берет, – таких хороших баб надо в Крым отправлять, чтоб их там волки-медведи кушали…
cases.explain: «хороших баб» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: ‘"Nice women like that, the man with the black moustache retorted sadly, ‘"‘nice women like that should be shipped to the Crimea and fed to the wolves."

cases.sentence: А потом торжественно помолчала – и снова протянула мне стакан: «Плесни еще, ___, а не то упаду в обморок».
cases.explain: «молодой человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: She drank it and, in place of a thank you, she lifted up the beret from her head: "Look here, do you see that?" And she showed us all a scar above her ear, and then was majestically silent, and then extended her glass toward me once more: "Hit me again, young man, otherwise I'll faint."
